title: zia_admin_roles role_type validator rejects PUBLIC_API even though API returns it

blocks.code:
Terraform v1.9.8
on darwin_arm64
+ provider registry.terraform.io/zscaler/zia v4.7.18

blocks.text: N/A — failure is at plan-time validation / pre-API-call enum check, not a runtime API error.

`role_type = "PUBLIC_API"` should validate, plan, and apply cleanly. The ZIA API returns `PUBLIC_API` for any admin role created in the ZIA admin console using the "API" / "Public API" template, so the provider's enum validator should accept it.

Without this, every API role imported from an existing tenant must use `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [role_type] }` to silence the catch-22, and pure-Terraform creation of new API roles is impossible (the validator runs before the API call, so `PUBLIC_API` never reaches the tenant).

blocks.text: The provider's plan-time validator enum on `role_type` does not include `PUBLIC_API`, but the resource's own update logic enforces immutability against the imported state value, producing a no-win situation.

blocks.item: In the ZIA admin console, create an admin role with the "API" / "Public API" template (or use an existing one — typical for `terraform-zia`-style API integration roles).
Write HCL with `role_type = "PUBLIC_API"` → `terraform plan` fails with enum validator error.
Remove `role_type` from HCL → `terraform plan` fails with `cannot be changed` error.
Only workaround: keep `role_type` omitted and add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [role_type] }`.
Tenant authenticates via OneAPI / Zidentity OAuth2 client_credentials (vanity domain → `https://api.zscaler.com`, base `https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/`).

`GET /adminRoles` returns `roleType: "PUBLIC_API"` for every API-only role in the tenant — confirmed against multiple roles created independently over time and by different admins, so this is not a one-off tenant artifact.
Affected our 4 existing API roles. All four imported successfully but require the `lifecycle.ignore_changes` workaround to plan.

blocks.text: Update the validator on the `role_type` attribute in the `zia_admin_roles` schema (likely `zia/resource_zia_admin_roles.go` or equivalent) to include `PUBLIC_API` in the accepted enum, and cross-check with the ZIA REST API contract for `/adminRoles` to ensure the full list of server-supported values (e.g. there may be other valid types currently missing as well) is reflected.
